ideas.risks: Most of this work is bibliographic and can stall if canonical theorems in KMV08/Feldman/potential frameworks already assume richer interface than fixed 0/1 excess-risk; some papers may only be conditionally equivalent under distribution-specific or realizability variants.
ideas.summary: Build a theorem-accurate compatibility matrix for each candidate booster family (KMV08, Feldman 2008/2012 variants, potential-based boosting): exact source theorem ID, weak-oracle contract, required output format (hypothesis/edge predictor/confidence), conversion of err≤OPT+β to its (α,γ) form, final excess form (OPT+ε vs OPT+α+ε), and precise polynomial dependence on ε, β, and failure probability.
ideas.title: Oracle-semantics compatibility matrix to close Route D
ideas.why_promising: This directly resolves the highest-priority blocker and prevents false-positive claims; once complete, any subsequent positive/negative route is either immediately constrained or ruled out.

ideas.risks: Dependence between rounds may invalidate standard concentration; adaptive filters can change support in adversarial ways and may require heavy stopping-time machinery; lower bounds could become only conjectural unless a concrete class/distribution is fixed.
ideas.summary: Develop an adaptive estimability lemma for γ_t=1/2−OPT_C(D_t): design computable surrogate statistics from reweighted samples with stopping-time confidence bounds (e.g., self-normalized martingale/Freedman-style inequalities) showing γ_t can be certified to polynomial precision in 1/ε and 1/(1/2−β) each round.
ideas.title: Adaptive high-confidence estimation of round-wise γ_t
ideas.why_promising: If achievable, it removes the principal noncomputability objection and could directly unlock the conditional reduction route by turning it into an operational algorithm.

ideas.risks: Candidate wrapper invariants are often mutually incompatible (mass floor may force weak filtering), and proofs may require new anti-concentration arguments specific to adversarially adaptive instance weighting.
ideas.summary: Define and analyze one explicit residual/filter family with a potential function proving simultaneously: (i) per-round acceptance mass ≥1/poly(n,1/ε), and (ii) OPT_C(D_t) stays bounded away from 1/2 by an observable γ_t, with closed-form recursive updates and cost accounting.
ideas.title: One concrete wrapper with provable mass-gap invariants
ideas.why_promising: A single fully proven wrapper plus existing compatible boosting theorem would provide the first unconditional positive result for the edge under atlas semantics.

ideas.risks: Constructing a quantified witness is technically delicate; proving low original OPT while high filtered OPT persists under adaptive filtering may require nonstandard distribution design and careful representation assumptions.
ideas.summary: Search for a fixed class C and an explicit distribution+filter update map F where OPT_C(D) ≤ o(1) but adaptive filtering in the reduction drives OPT_C(D_t)→1/2 or acceptance mass to superpolynomially small within poly rounds; formalize full ∀/∃ quantifiers and complexity model.
ideas.title: Quantified obstruction witness for route-A failure
ideas.why_promising: A hard counterexample with explicit quantifiers would settle the implication negatively (or at least show which wrapper families cannot work) in a way stronger than stress-test narratives.

ideas.risks: SQ/lower-bound transfer may not align exactly with binary 0/1 prediction oracle and improper-output hypothesis class, and may only give conditional hardness under additional cryptographic or average-case assumptions.
ideas.summary: Model the fixed-β oracle as a finite-precision SQ/statistical interface and prove no polynomial-time ε-amplification from constant-offset excess outputs under this interface for generic classes unless β can be effectively shrunk by wrapper, potentially using precision-noise barriers.
ideas.title: SQ/precision barrier formalization near β≈1/2
ideas.why_promising: Could convert the recurring β-boundary fragility intuition into a conditional impossibility statement and explain why polynomial-time amplification may be intrinsically blocked.

ideas.risks: These assumptions may be too restrictive and could narrow scope; proving them might be hard and may only give brittle theorem with strong distribution/class conditions.
ideas.summary: Prove the implication under explicit regularity assumptions (e.g., Tsybakov/ Massart noise with margin, bounded density reweighting stability, or distributional stability condition) and derive a clean conditional theorem where fixed-slack weak learner plus boosting gives full ε-agnostic target in polynomial time.
ideas.title: Conditional positive theorem under noise/stability assumptions
ideas.why_promising: Even if unconditional edge stays open, a strong conditional theorem is mathematically useful and can later guide whether the general case is truly blocked or just currently unclosed.
